en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style image of a riverside industrial town. In the foreground two long side‑wheel steamers are moored along a quay; their paddle boxes bear the names "JOHN PENN" and "LIBUSSA." Smoke rises lightly from one funnel. Behind the riverbank stands a station or small riverside building, a cobbled embankment with horse‑drawn wagons and carts, and rail tracks with a freight wagon. On the hill above are factories with tall chimneys, mixed with townhouses, trees, and a church with a slender spire.
